name: Create Like On Share
description: Creates a like on a share. [See the docs here](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/integrations/community-management/shares/network-update-social-actions#create-a-like-on-a-share)

configurable_props.name: parentUrn
configurable_props.label: Parent Urn
configurable_props.description: The top-level share urn or user generated content where the like will be performed.

configurable_props.name: actor
configurable_props.label: Actor
configurable_props.description: Entity performing the like. Must be a person or an organization URN.

configurable_props.name: object
configurable_props.label: Object
configurable_props.description: Use the `object` field in the request body to specify the URN of the entity to which the like belongs. This object should be a sub-entity of the top-level share indicated in the request URL
